instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Marine conservation is the protection of marine life and ecosystems. One way for everybody to help is to reduce plastic use and recycle as much as possible.

Sustainable fishing should also be practised. This involves using fishing gear that is less harmful to the ocean and catching fish at a rate that allows them to continue reproducing so their population does not decline.

Highly Protected Marine Areas are another important part of marine conservation. HPMAs are areas of the sea where all harmful activities like fishing or oil drilling are banned. This allows for the protection of marine ecosystems so they can recover to their natural state.
